originalTitle: Wall Street ends mixed as investors focus on tech earnings
summary: STORY: Wall Street ended mixed on Monday, with the Dow gaining half a percent, the S&P 500 virtually flat and the Nasdaq dropping marginally. Investors awaited earnings results from Big Tech companies this week, including Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple. Of the four, only Apple has seen significant gains this year, with investors concerned about future returns on massive AI spending. Skyler Weinand is chief investment officer at Regan Capital. "If they don't come out and beat [estimates], they're going to sell off even further. You're going to see some profit taking. You're going to see some hedge funds and retail [investors] potentially pack it in for the rest of the year, sitting up 10 to 15%. I don't blame them. // I don't really see the opportunity for these companies that have run so much over the past 18 to 24 months on that AI build out. I don't see that as a huge buying opportunity. I would rather be looking at some of the companies that have fallen behind a little bit. Auto manufacturers are having their day right now. Defense companies are having their day. Some of these companies that will continue to print earnings regardless of what comes from AI build out." The Philadelphia semiconductor index extended its recent selloff, falling more than 2%. It is down 21% from its record high close on June 22 but remains up 63% in 2026. Chinese chipmaker CXMT's stellar debut on Monday and a report that the country has started manufacturing homegrown deep ultraviolet chipmaking tools also signaled intensifying competition for the U.S. semiconductor industry. Meanwhile, oil prices slid after President Donald Trump said the administration was having "good talks" with Iran, but warned that U.S. strikes would resume if the negotiations failed to deliver. Shares of Occidental Petroleum fell more than 4% and Exxon Mobil also closed lower. Traders this week will also turn their attention to Tuesday's start of the Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting, with traders projecting a more than 60% chance that the central bank will leave rates unchanged, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

chineseTitle: 投资者关注科技股盈利，华尔街收盘涨跌互现
chineseSummary: 故事：华尔街周一收盘涨跌不一，道指上涨 0.5%，标准普尔 500 指数几乎持平，纳斯达克指数小幅下跌。投资者等待本周微软、亚马逊、Meta 和苹果等大型科技公司的财报。在这四家公司中，只有苹果公司今年取得了显着收益，投资者担心大规模人工智能支出的未来回报。斯凯勒·韦南德 (Skyler Weinand) 是里根资本 (Regan Capital) 的首席投资官。 “如果他们不出来并超出[预期]，他们将进一步抛售。你会看到一些获利回吐。你会看到一些对冲基金和散户[投资者]可能会在今年剩余时间里进行投资，上涨 10% 到 15%。我不会责怪他们。//我真的不认为这些公司在过去 18 到 24 个月里依靠人工智能构建运行了这么多的机会。我我不认为这是一个巨大的买入机会，我宁愿关注一些稍微落后的汽车制造商现在正在享受他们的日子，无论人工智能的发展如何，这些公司都会继续盈利。”费城半导体指数延续近期跌势，跌幅超过 2%。较 6 月 22 日创下的历史高位收盘价下跌了 21%，但 2026 年仍将上涨 63%。中国芯片制造商长鑫存储周一的出色亮相以及有关中国已开始制造国产深紫外芯片制造工具的报道也表明美国半导体行业的竞争加剧。与此同时，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示政府正在与伊朗进行“良好谈判”，但警告称，如果谈判未能取得成果，美国将恢复打击，导致油价下跌。西方股票
